BiblicalUsage: The word is murmuring, grumbling against God and His servants. In the morning Israel shall see the glory of the Lord, for He heareth their murmurings against Him; Moses says, What are we, your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord. God asks how long the evil congregation shall murmur against Him, and says the rod of Aaron shall take away their murmurings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe murmuring is never only against Moses; it is against the Lord who brought them out. My position is that the grumbling of Israel is a mirror for my own heart, and the manna came in the morning anyway.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
